name: pagerank
author: f3b11984
description: Ranks nodes by overall importance using PageRank, computed by power iteration: a node is important when important nodes link to it. Use for questions about the most influential, important, central or well-connected-to nodes (key airports, main characters, top papers). Works on directed and undirected graphs; dangling nodes are handled. By default edge weights are used as link strength when the graph has them; pass weighted=false to ignore them (for example on airports, where weight is a distance in km). Returns the top_k nodes with id, label, rank and score; scores over all nodes sum to 1.

graph_id.description: ID of the graph to analyse.

damping.description: Probability of following a link instead of jumping to a random node; from 0 up to but not including 1.

top_k.description: How many top-ranked nodes to return.

weighted.description: Use edge weights as link strength when the graph has weights (default true). Set false to treat every edge equally, e.g. when weights are distances.
